# bioexcel/biobb_haddock/topology

## Summary

Wrapper class for the HADDOCK3 Topology module.

The Topology module. HADDOCK3 Topology module creates a topology from a system to be used for docking.

Nextflow adapter of the [Topology](https://biobb-haddock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/haddock.html#module-haddock.topology) building block of [biobb_haddock](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_haddock) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_HADDOCK_TOPOLOGY } from 'bioexcel/biobb_haddock/topology'

workflow {
    BIOBB_HADDOCK_TOPOLOGY(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `mol1_input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |
| `mol2_input_pdb_path` | no | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |
| `haddock_config_path` | no | cfg | Haddock configuration CFG file path |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_haddock_wf_data` | yes | zip | Path to the output zipball containing all the current Haddock workflow data |
| `mol1_output_top_zip_path` | no, opt-in | zip | Path to the output PDB file collection in zip format |
| `mol2_output_top_zip_path` | no, opt-in | zip | Path to the output PDB file collection in zip format |
| `versions_biobb_haddock` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_haddock', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Topology properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[mol1_output_top_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_haddock container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_HADDOCK_TOPOLOGY' {
        ext.properties = [global_cfg: [postprocess: false]]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cfg` | object | {} | Haddock configuration options specification. |
| `global_cfg` | object | {"postprocess": false} | Global configuration options specification. |
| `binary_path` | string | "haddock" | Path to the haddock haddock executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
